title: Translation estimate bounds the double integral over r-balls
statement:
Let n ∈ ℕ and E := ℝ^n (Eucl n) with Lebesgue measure L. Let u : E → ℝ be measurable, Λ ∈ [0, ∞] and r ∈ ℝ, with no sign condition on r. Assume ∫⁻ ofReal|u(x + h) − u(x)| dL(x) ≤ ofReal(‖h‖)·Λ for every h ∈ E. Then
∫⁻_x ∫⁻_{y ∈ closedBall(x, r)} ofReal|u(x) − u(y)| dL(y) dL(x) ≤ ofReal(r)·Λ·L(closedBall(0, r))
in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) (r : ℝ), Measurable u → (∀ h : Eucl n, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal |u (x + h) - u x| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * Λ) → ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y in closedBall x r, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - u y| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r * Λ * volume (closedBall (0 : Eucl n) r)
